description: Roof deck assembly. Net deck area (AREA SF, openings over the threshold deducted per F4) drives sheet count, fasteners, install hours, and crane time (P29). Sheets round UP to whole-sheet increments. Qualifying openings also generate framed-opening steel adds and install labor, each citing the OPENING row's item_id.
provenance: SEED 2026-06-12. Sheet geometry, fastening density, and hour factors seeded pending PC7 shop actuals and Owner review. Changes are file diffs proposed to Owner, never chat-session overrides.

framed_adds.description: deck opening header angle, two per opening

labor_hours.description: fit and install opening frame and headers, hours per opening

materials.description: roof deck sheets, 3.0 ft cover width x 30.0 ft length, 90 SF per sheet
deck fastening, support plus sidelap, per net SF

labor_hours.description: deck placement and fastening, hours per net SF

equipment_time.description: crane minutes for deck bundle hoisting, per net SF

notes: Deck supply and install is always Your Company scope (Bid Document Rules). Openings at or under deduct_threshold_sf are ignored, cut waste covers them; they are counted in the run report, never silently. The square geometry model (side = sqrt SF) sizes frame angles and headers; real opening dimensions from an opening schedule beat it when available.
